revision.correccion_en: On the right photo, dress the woman in a coral bikini with a modest full-coverage bottom (no thong cut). Move 'ANTES' and 'DESPUÉS' slightly down so their tops sit at least 6% of the canvas height from the top edge. Add more side margin to the card row so every card text, including '(CON TUS COMIDAS)' and 'NI QUIRÓFANO', stays at least 6% of the canvas width away from the left and right edges.
